cases.input:
# suites.yaml — named NeMo Evaluator runs for the lab (clients/nemo-evaluator/README.md documents the schema).
#
# Every suite names a router model alias and 1-8 benchmarks; `max_problems` is REQUIRED (a bounded, shuffled
# sample; seed 42) so no run is ever accidentally the whole dataset. Allowed benchmarks: gsm8k, mmlu, math500,
# mmlu_pro, triviaqa, drop. Docker-sandbox and LLM-judge benchmarks are refused by the validator. Datasets must be
# prefetched first:  evaluator-local prefetch gsm8k mmlu
version: 1
suites:
  smoke-lightning:
    description: 10 GSM8K problems on Nemotron Lightning (fast, thinking off) - proves the whole path in seconds.
    model: aitop/nemotron-lightning
    benchmarks:
      - bench: gsm8k
        max_problems: 10
        max_tokens: 1024
  knowledge-lightning:
    description: 50 MMLU questions on Lightning - a rough knowledge sanity check.
    model: aitop/nemotron-lightning
    benchmarks:
      - bench: mmlu
        max_problems: 50
        max_tokens: 1024
  baseline-lightning:
    description: 100 GSM8K + 100 MMLU problems on Lightning - a quick before/after baseline for engine changes.
    model: aitop/nemotron-lightning
    benchmarks:
      - bench: gsm8k
        max_problems: 100
        max_tokens: 1024
      - bench: mmlu
        max_problems: 100
        max_tokens: 1024

# Every suite names a router model alias and 1-8 benchmarks; `max_problems` is REQUIRED (a bounded, shuffled
# sample; seed 42) so no run is ever accidentally the whole dataset. Allowed benchmarks: gsm8k, mmlu, math500,
# mmlu_pro, triviaqa, drop. Docker-sandbox and LLM-judge benchmarks are refused by the validator. Datasets must be
# prefetched first:  evaluator-local prefetch gsm8k mmlu
version: 1
suites:
  smoke-lightning:
    description: 10 !GSM8K problems on Nemotron Lightning (fast, thinking off) - proves the whole path in seconds.
    model: aitop/nemotron-lightning
    benchmarks:
      - bench: gsm8k
        max_problems: 10
        max_tokens: 1024
  knowledge-lightning:
    description: 50 MMLU questions on Lightning - a rough knowledge sanity check.
    model: aitop/nemotron-lightning
    benchmarks:
      - bench: mmlu
        max_problems: 50
        max_tokens: 1024
  baseline-lightning:
    description: 100 GSM8K + 100 MMLU problems on Lightning - a quick before/after baseline for engine changes.
    model: aitop/nemotron-lightning
    benchmarks:
      - bench: gsm8k
        max_problems: 100
        max_tokens: 10x24
      - bench: mmlu
        max_problems: 100
        max_tokens: 1024

  smoke-lightning:
    description: 10 GSM8K problems on Nemotron Lightning (fast, thinking off) - proves the whole path in seconds.
    model: aitop/nemotron-lightning
    benchmarks:
      - bench: gsm8k
        max_problems: 10
        max_tokens: 1024
  knowledge-lightning:
    description: 50 MMLU questions on Lightning - a rough knowledge sanity check.
    model: aitop/nemotron-lightning
    benchmarks:
      - bench: mmlu
        max_problems: 50
        max_tokens: 1024
  baseline-lightning:
    description: 100GSM8K + 100 MMLU problems on Lightning - a quick before/after baseline for engine changes.
    model: aitop/nemotron-lightning
    benchmarks:
      - bench: gsm8k
        max_problems: 100
        max_tokens: 1024
      - bench: mmlu
        max_problems: 100
        max_tokens: 1024
